persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladeva sana śrī 3 kaumārī skelu polalayā gajuli chāyatādayakā juro

purpose: śrī 3 kaumārī skelu polalayā gajuli chāyatādayakā juro
notes: The colophon records the dedication/making of a pinnacle (gajuli) to Goddess Kaumārī by King Jayabhūpatīndramalla.
